title: PlaneMem session progress write bodies and historical success records
description: Source-only five write contracts. Raw HTTP bodies retain unknown fields for original fingerprints; strict client commands are separate. Returned activity/session records are original historical results on replay, not necessarily current state. Register session-activity-read.json and session-start.json.
$comment: Wire records are open where stored receipt reconstruction preserves extensions. Runtime additionally checks scope/target/command relationships, safe arithmetic, source associations and finite dates. SDK parsers are stricter than legacy HTTP/persistence and normalize finish sources. No validator/generator or machine-contract consumption evidence.

sessionSources.description: Exactly the original parent session ID. Receipt reader allows source extensions/revision/URI; strict create clients require only type/id.

runSources.description: Exactly the tool's run_id, extensions/revision/URI preserved on wire. Strict create client only permits type/id; finish client normalizes four fields.

date.description: Stored receipt requires finite Date.parse, not canonical ISO, a128-character bound or timestamp chronology. Fresh timestamps are ISO; stricter finish client checks length<=128 and end>=start but preserves text.

session_id.description: If present, overwritten by route before command execution/fingerprint; process raw-body cache still sees original value.

expected_version.description: Effective header version wins; without header must be positive safe number for fresh mutation. Raw body may otherwise differ/be ignored; durable fingerprint uses effective value.

rawBase.description: Legacy HTTP allows extra body fields and retains them in durable fingerprint after path overrides and effective version replacement, deleting idempotency_key. Key required in header or body; both must agree. Exact optional claimed identity must match verified caller. Fresh expected_version>=1, valid0 reaches service rejection; no silent version default.

model.description: Any JSON accepted at HTTP field extraction: nonempty strings retained, empty/nonstring omitted for execution; original value still fingerprints. Whitespace-only retained string fails fresh transition. No1024 bound here.

run_id.description: Overwritten by path before durable fingerprint.

rawRunFinish.description: Child version required in body, no separate child version header. Generic extractor accepts0; fresh transition requires>=1.

rawToolCall.description: New record requires running parent session and same-session running run. Tool status may already be terminal; this records metadata without executing a tool. Fresh tool_name nonblank, no1024 bound.

tool_call_id.description: Overwritten by path before durable fingerprint.

rawToolFinish.description: Child version required in body. Generic extractor accepts0, fresh transition requires>=1 and ULID tool target.

clientBase.description: Shared strict new-command fields, not raw HTTP or historical query. Original session/actor/client and optional key bind to original context. SDK public methods have a smaller business-input/options surface.

clientRunStart.description: New client creation must leave room for session+1; optional model nonblank<=1024 UTF-16/no controls/DEL/lone surrogates and retained verbatim.

clientRunFinish.description: Maximum safe session/child versions allowed for an unchanged terminal result; a changed result requires room for both+1.

run.description: Complete historical run on wire. session_version is historical parent version, version is child version. Persisted extensions survive; trace/model have no stored per-string1024 bound. No timestamps, execution output or live-state guarantee.

runStart.description: session_version=original expected_version+1; sequence positive int32; model matches original execution normalization. Same saved run remains running/version1 in historical replay even if current run finished.

runFinish.description: Child and parent versions equal their original expected values plus same delta0/1. changed is internal/lookup metadata, not added by ordinary response. Wire saved sources can be empty/arbitrarily many; stricter finish client requires<=200 and matching session source.

tool.description: Historical tool metadata only. Sources exactly original agent-run ID; source extensions survive. No actual tool execution/output/time/duration proof, no per-tool-name length bound on wire.

toolCall.description: session_version=original expected_version+1; original run/name/status preserved, terminal-at-creation allowed. Does not increment the referenced run version.

toolFinish.description: Child/parent versions share delta0/1 from their original expectations. Run version/status and parent status/ended_at unchanged; original current run relation must exist for fresh write and replay, not for receipt-only lookup.

resume.description: Stored origin structure only; no referenced record/current ownership/pack validation.

end.description: Historical full ended session; version=original expected_version or+1. actor/client are original session creator, may differ from closing caller. Wire reader does not enforce name bounds, source membership/count, parent!=self or end>=start; finish SDK additionally does. Source/session extensions survive historical wire replay; SDK reconstructs known fields.

envelope.description: Built-in HTTP commandResult: current outer trace, original saved record/sources inside and outside, no ETag/outer revision/changed. No full-response byte limit or whole-handler deadline. SDK accepts optional matching ETag as compatibility, not built-in output.
